heading.purpose: One per page of the document.

label.purpose: Field names, tabs, navigation: uppercase, tracked.

shadows.purpose: A page lying on the desk.
shadows.name: page

shadows.purpose: A picture mounted on a page.
shadows.name: mount

motion.purpose: A stamp lands once when its page comes into view.
motion.name: stamp-land

components.name: Copy button
components.description: The only filled button: copies the chosen install command.
components.css: .ds-copy { padding: 0.62em 1.35em; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #151a2e); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink, #151a2e); color: var(--paper, #f2f5fa); font: 700 0.8125rem/1 B612, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-copy:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #151a2e); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foil, #7b4e06); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top-bar tool
components.description: Language, theme and GitHub in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-tool { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #b7c0d5); border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--ink, #151a2e); font: 700 0.75rem/1 B612, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-tool:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #151a2e); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foil, #7b4e06); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A label over a value on a dotted rule, as on a passport's data page.
components.html: Commands99 on Windows, 114 on Linux
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 3px; max-width: 280px; } .ds-field-label { font: 700 0.75rem/1.4 B612, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #434a69); } .ds-field-value { padding-bottom: 7px; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--ink-2, #434a69); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.4 "Overpass Mono", Consolas, monospace; color: var(--ink, #151a2e); }

components.name: Command block
components.description: One install command, wrapped where it must be.
components.css: .ds-command { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel, #151a2e); color: var(--panel-ink, #e8ecf6); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 "Overpass Mono", Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Entry stamp
components.description: A system the product is valid on, as an entry stamp in one of the three inks.
components.css: .ds-entry { display: inline-grid; justify-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 18px 34px; border: 3px double var(--ink-teal, #0a6672); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink-teal, #0a6672); transform: rotate(-1.5deg); } .ds-entry b { font: 400 1.3rem/1 "Castoro Titling", serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-entry span { font: 700 0.75rem/1.2 B612, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.northStar: A travel document, valid in three systems
narrative.overview: Each section is a page of a passport lying on a desk: security paper with fine line work, a picture of the real program mounted like the holder's photograph, a rubber stamp carrying one measured fact, and a machine-readable band holding the install command. The dark theme is the cover: navy with gold foil.
keyCharacteristics: Guilloche line work as CSS masks in the logo's three inks
Stamps as inline SVG through one ink filter
Real pictures and measured numbers only
Fonts, pictures and video ship with the page

rules.body: A stamp sits on the paper below its picture and bites one corner; it never lies over the dark picture.
rules.name: Ink goes on paper

rules.body: Line work is black SVG used as a mask over a gradient of the inks.
rules.name: One mask, two themes

rules.body: Its punctuation sits at the left of the cell, so addresses read wrongly. Commands use Overpass Mono.
rules.name: No B612 Mono

dos: Put one measured fact on a stamp and repeat it in the aria-label.
Record pictures from the program with tools/promo.ps1 -Stills.
Add the Chinese for every data-i18n key.
donts: Don't load anything from another host.
Don't animate anything but the stamps.
Don't quote users, downloads or stars.
